status: Partial hostile ordnance foundation, not completed boss ports or ordinary enemy entries.
previous_goal_turn: Progress: Loki controllers, dedicated pools and validation artifacts changed authoritative state; the finalized Loki checkpoint was inspected.
evidence_boundary: Hornfel and The Horny Boys pages specify thrown bombs with Hot/Sad effects and short-delay Brimstone bombs. They do not give native damage, trajectory, fuse, probability or owner-immunity constants.

The Sad Bombs item page gives a ten-shot ring; Brimstone Bombs gives four cardinal lasers; Hot Bombs describes contact and residual fire. Payload shapes use these effects, but player damage and player item modifiers are not imported into hostile behavior.
XML provides component names/tuples, not native boss spawn call identity. Hostile Sad may use a Bloody Sad variant or flags; the current tuple is a candidate presentation identity.
REPENTOGON exposes bomb countdown and fall-speed API. It does not establish the 1.7.9b boss attack timings or payload faction policy.
The saved game_bomb_explosion_effects.asm is an existing generic explosion-effects slice; it is not used here as proof of the unexamined boss-specific spawn/update paths.
Repentance+ 1% drop changes are outside this baseline.
implemented: External immutable bomb profiles with finite validated dimensions/timers, effect-specific configuration and missing-effect rejection.
Real terrain-aware ballistic throwing or dropping, with original source identity retained separately from ordnance identity.
Normal blast, Hot contact plus lingering flame, ten-shot Sad ring and four cover-clipped Brimstone rays.
Hostile player/companion effects use their existing shared hurt windows; hostile payloads do not resolve player builds or damage stats.
Declared source-immunity flag affects blast recipients without excluding nearby unrelated enemies.

Sad burst preflights event and projectile capacity, keeping the entire armed payload pending if capacity is insufficient. Normal immediate blasts also retain delayed work when event capacity is temporarily unavailable.
Active/pending ordnance remains bounded. Dormant room fuses and residual effects pause; residual fields survive producer death and room-clear cleanup.
Armed payloads have distinct sphere/flame/face/mine geometry; aftermath uses the Original fire and beam renderer.

local_policies.pending_queue: An overflow bomb begins its fuse when admitted to active storage. Capacities are global, including dormant rooms; no unbounded per-room multiplication.
local_policies.geometry: Effects detonate at the actual 3D charge position; shots/beams originate 0.67 units above it. Beam endpoints are clipped against terrain/cover before blast demolition, and sight is checked again on impact.
local_policies.death_and_clear: Independent armed charges and residual fields survive actor death and ordinary clear, pause offscreen, and retire at their configured lifetime. Explicit debugging clear/floor replacement removes them.

unresolved: Native boss-specific payload identity/flags, chances, trajectory and fuse constants.
Hostile Hot flame durability, projectile interception and damage/faction behavior must be measured; the player item four-hit durability is not claimed for this hostile field.
Native shot/laser damage and exact tick policy; existing DeathWard shared player/companion hurt windows are local adaptations.
Bomb pushing by tears/lasers, explosion impulse, contact with allied bodies before detonation and special item/character exceptions are not implemented by this payload foundation.
No native Hornfel or Horny Boys producer is implemented here; source immunity and owner-independent effect lifetime require validation against those encounters.
No varied-build/human balance or controlled rendered Linux/WASM performance acceptance.
Armed models are small at default camera distance; some beams reach outside the view and fire/explosion effects overlap. Full readability acceptance remains open.
